note: Inbox material for SRC; not a source text and not exported to M. blob = Git blob at pin after the split; a class names what was found before the split, after_split what goes to M. moved_to names the judge-only table that now carries the text (J-only; not to be repeated in M).
classification_rule: rule: only protocol/form/order, names and counts of cases allowed; case: only case answers, no rule absent from a norm; mixed: both — split before export. An expected answer is the literal outcome tied to a named case/step; stated rules with a scenario pointer stay.

residual_for_architect: Remaining stand protocol lines naming a scenario and a time budget, not in Sleeps sections (06/4 README «Scenario 04 admits 150 s…», 06/5 «deadline of 90 s of sc. 14») left as runner budget; say if they should move too.
limits: Rules-only check of moved material was by reading and targeted grep of norms, not an exhaustive proof that every sentence moved has a norm counterpart; the moved text stays verbatim in the judge tables, so nothing is lost.
Acceptance READMEs were classified line by line; norm files only for the N5 table and scenario-answer ties, not for the normative text itself (norm text is rule by definition).
not_filter: Filter itself is SRC work; this list gives classes and blobs only.
